title.value: AICOM-MP: AN AI- BASED MONKEYPOX DETECTOR FOR RESOURCE -CONSTRAINED ENVIRONMENTS
title.justification: The title directly mentions the development of an AI-based monkeypox detector for resource-constrained environments.
title.quote: AICOM-MP: AN AI- BASED MONKEYPOX DETECTOR FOR RESOURCE -CONSTRAINED ENVIRONMENTS

extractions.description: The paper discusses the development and implementation of AICOM-MP, an AI-based monkeypox detector specifically designed for use in resource-constrained environments. AICOM-MP operates under Autonomous Mobile Clinics (AMCs) to improve healthcare access in least developed countries by offering state-of-the-art monkeypox screening through a web service. The paper emphasizes the importance of dataset robustness, attention models, and computing optimization in health AI engines. It also highlights how AMCs aim to meet healthcare needs, particularly in underserved regions, aligning with Sustainable Development Goal 3 on health.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on healthcare technology development for resource-constrained environments and improving healthcare access through AI technologies in Autonomous Mobile Clinics. While healthcare access is critical for sustainable development, it is not directly climate or ecologically-related.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: we are developing, open sourcing, and standardizing health AI technologies to enable healthcare access in least developed countries (LDCs).

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily addresses health technology development and accessibility rather than any specific climate or ecological sustainable development goals.
primary_category.quote: Under the Autonomous Mobile Clinics (AMCs) initiative, we are developing, open sourcing, and standardizing health AI technologies to enable healthcare access in least developed countries (LDCs).

primary_sub_category.justification: The focus of the paper is not on a specific climate or ecological sub-category, but rather on healthcare technology and accessibility in resource-constrained environments.
primary_sub_category.quote: AICOM-MP, an AI-based monkeypox detector specially aiming for handling images taken from resource-constrained devices.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on developing AI technologies for healthcare applications in resource-limited settings, highlighting the adaptation of AI for low-resource healthcare delivery.
new_primary_category.quote: Facing the recent global monkeypox outbreak, in this article, we introduce AICOM-MP, an AI-based monkeypox detector specially aiming for handling images taken from resource-constrained devices.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper specifically deals with AI-based diagnostics for monkeypox, emphasizing the utility of AI in augmenting healthcare services in environments where resources are limited.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: we introduce AICOM-MP, an AI-based monkeypox detector that has achieved SOTA performance.
